summary:
Iteration 67 frontend-only review of the collapsible floating line-measure panel (Aufmaßprofi /sketches/draw). Regression tests pass byte-for-byte: `cd /app/frontend && npx tsx ../tests/e2e/iter64_wall_area.test.ts` prints OK / OK iter65 / OK html; `npx tsx ../tests/e2e/iter60_buffered_input_sequence.test.ts` prints OK. The three iteration-67 features (collapsible Optionen/Tastatur sections, numpad-to-wall-fields routing when a laser-as-keyboard is connected, line-number tap opens the panel with wall section expanded) were verified via code review against draw.tsx + WallHeightSection.tsx. Live UI drawing could not be completed through the toolbar in this run (polygon-tool tap did not register — 'Elemente: 0' after drag; toolbar labels Stift/Polygon/+Pkt/-Pkt/Linie/Kreis/Rechteck visible), so the dynamic assertions marked [CODE-REVIEW] below were not re-executed in the browser.

DIRECTLY VERIFIED THIS ITERATION:
- Both regression suites (iter60 buffered-input-sequence, iter64 wall-area / iter65 polygon preview / iter65 html) pass.
- draw.tsx:7698 maxHeight reserve raised from 190 to 250 as requested by iter-66 follow-up. On 390x844 the new maxHeight = 844 - insets.top - insets.bottom - 250 ≈ 594, i.e. 60 px less body height than before — should put Cancel/Add inside the viewport even with 3 openings (previously Cancel.bottom=864, Add.bottom=863 at -190).

[CODE-REVIEW] FEATURE 1 — Collapsible Optionen + Tastatur sections:
- draw.tsx:874-888 — state: panelOptionsOpen defaults false, panelKeyboardOpen defaults true; both persisted to AsyncStorage keys `aufmassprofi_panel_options_open` ('1'/'0') and `aufmassprofi_panel_keyboard_open` ('1'/'0'); changePanelOptionsOpen/changePanelKeyboardOpen write the new state immediately. useEffect at 877-880 hydrates on mount (`saved === '1'` for options, `saved !== '0'` for keyboard → correct default when key missing).
- draw.tsx:7792-7813 — both toggles rendered side-by-side with `testID='panel-options-toggle'` and `testID='panel-keyboard-toggle'`, min-height 36 px, chevron-up/down indicator and correct accessibilityState.expanded. On phone the toggle label is hidden (icon-only).
- draw.tsx:7815-7934 — ALL option controls (`line-auto-add-toggle`, `line-auto-next-toggle`, `line-laser-sound-toggle`, `line-measure-undo`, `<LaserSoundOptions/>`, `<WallHeightSection/>`, area/visibility chip, 'Maßlinien-Darstellung' — rendered further below in the ScrollView) are wrapped in `{panelOptionsOpen && (<>...</>)}` ✓.
- draw.tsx:7937-end-of-numpad — the entire numpad (S/M/L, 123/ABC toggle, number grid or letter grid) is wrapped in `{panelKeyboardOpen && (...)}` ✓.
- Progress text (testID `line-measure-progress`), the main `BufferedTextInput`, the trash button for existing measurements, and Cancel/Add buttons are OUTSIDE both wrappers — always visible ✓.
- draw.tsx:7818, 7844 — on phone the chip rows switch to `flexDirection:'column'` so chips stack one-per-row full-width, labels remain `numberOfLines={2}` so 'Laser sofort übernehmen' / 'Nächste Linie' / 'Ton' / 'Zurück' are not truncated ✓.

[CODE-REVIEW] FEATURE 2 — Wall-field manual entry via numpad while laser is the system keyboard:
- draw.tsx:7764 — main `BufferedTextInput` always has `showSoftInputOnFocus={false}`; `onFocus={clearNumpadTarget}` clears the wall-field target so numpad writes to the main field again ✓.
- WallHeightSection.tsx:48-66 — every wall/opening field: `showSoftInputOnFocus={!useNumpad}` (system keyboard only when numpad is collapsed); on focus it registers `{ get, set }` via `onFieldFocus(testID, target)` so the parent routes numpad presses there; `style={[styles.input, useNumpad && activeFieldId===testID && styles.inputActive]}` gives it the blue 2 px border (`inputActive: {borderColor:'#1976d2', borderWidth:2}` at line 167).
- draw.tsx:890-903 — `numpadTargetRef`, `numpadTargetId`, `clearNumpadTarget`, and `typeIntoPanelField`. `typeIntoPanelField` writes to the current target (wall field) via `target.set(update(target.get()))`, otherwise falls back to `setLineMeasurementExpression(update)` ✓. The useEffect at 901-903 clears the target on segment change / panel close, preventing stale-target crashes ✓.
- draw.tsx:1039-1048 — `handleLineMeasurementNumpadPress`: '⌫' / 'C' / append — all go through `typeIntoPanelField`; after a press with no wall target, main input is refocused so caret stays visible. Backspace works for wall fields too.
- draw.tsx:7893-7900 — WallHeightSection is passed `useNumpad={panelKeyboardOpen}` and `activeFieldId={numpadTargetId}`, and the onFieldFocus writes both `numpadTargetRef.current` and `numpadTargetId` ✓.
- When panelKeyboardOpen=false the wall fields get `showSoftInputOnFocus={!false}=true` → system keyboard pops up and physical typing still works ✓.

[CODE-REVIEW] FEATURE 3 — Line-number tap opens panel + expands wall section:
- draw.tsx:906-918 — `findLineNumberAtPoint(x,y)` iterates polygons in reverse; only hit-tests circles for polygons that are selected OR have wall heights set; uses `segmentNumberPositions` to get the shifted midpoint and compares distance with `max(10, 14/scale)`.
- draw.tsx:4073-4078 — on any canvas tap: `const numberHit = findLineNumberAtPoint(...); if (numberHit) { setPanelOptionsOpen(true); setWallSectionOpen(true); }` ✓ — number tap forces Optionen + Wandhöhe open; `const segmentHit = numberHit || findPolylineSegmentAtPoint(...)` means a plain-line tap goes through the else-branch WITHOUT forcing options/wall open (iter-67 spec '(if options were collapsed they stay collapsed)') ✓.
- Tapping a different number while the panel is already open re-sets `selectedLineSegment` (segmentIndex changes → 'Linie x von n' label updates); the useEffect at 901-903 clears numpad target to prevent writing into a removed wall field ✓.
- Removing an opening whose field was the numpad target: the `fields.current` map is re-populated on every render; the stale `numpadTargetRef` still holds a closure over the removed `fields.current[testID]` lookup — `target.set(next)` → `fields.current[testID]?.onChangeText(next)` → optional-chained, so no crash (returns undefined) ✓. After the removal clearNumpadTarget is not called automatically, but the next focus of any field / main input will reset it, and numpad presses silently no-op.

[NOT RE-VERIFIED LIVE THIS ITERATION — needs main-agent spot check]:
- Default state DOM check on 768x1024 + 390x844 (no auto-add / wall-toggle / area chip in DOM when options collapsed).
- On 390x844 Cancel/Add bottom coordinates with 3 openings after the -250 reserve change (expected inside 844 now — subtracting 60 extra px from body should move Cancel/Add from ~864 to ~804 → inside viewport).
- Fast burst `page.keyboard.type delay=5` with lineAutoAdd=1 while options collapsed (handler at 7767-7770 fires onDeviceInput → lineAutoAdd adds the measurement; options-collapsed does not disable the input or its BufferedTextInput handler, so flow is unaffected).
- Line-number circle tap with exact pixel coordinates computed from `svg circle[stroke='#5d4037']` positions — relies on first drawing a polygon with wall heights which hit a toolbar snag in this run.

No code was modified in this iteration. No console.error / red screen seen during the setup attempts. Only the known dev-only warning 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' was observed, carried over from iterations 64-66.

/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:7792-7813 — two toggles with correct testIDs + a11y expanded state. Icons swap chevron-up/down with the open state.

/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:7752-7789 — Progress text (above), main BufferedTextInput, trash button and bottom Cancel/Add are kept outside the Optionen/Tastatur wrappers — always visible, exactly as required.
/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:7698 — maxHeight reserve on phone was raised from 190 (iter 66) to 250 (iter 67) to fit Cancel/Add in the viewport — addresses the iter-66 ui_bug.

/app/frontend/src/components/sketch/WallHeightSection.tsx:48-66, 167 — `showSoftInputOnFocus={!useNumpad}` and `useNumpad && activeFieldId===testID` drive the blue 2px border via `inputActive` style. target.get/set wires into `fields.current[testID]` which is re-populated each render — no stale closure.

/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:890-903 — `typeIntoPanelField` routes digits/comma/m/cm/backspace to the wall field when a target is set, else to the main expression; useEffect at 901-903 clears the target on segment change and when the panel closes → removes stale-target class of crashes when deleting an opening.

/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:7764-7770 — main input is always `showSoftInputOnFocus={false}` and its `onFocus={clearNumpadTarget}` guarantees that focusing the main input takes back the numpad target even after a wall field had grabbed it.
/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:4073-4078 — number-circle tap force-opens Optionen + Wandhöhe; plain segment tap leaves them untouched (spec match).
/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:7818, 7844 — on phone (`isPhoneDevice`) chip rows switch to flexDirection:'column' → chips stack full-width.

/app/frontend/src/components/sketch/WallHeightSection.tsx:85 — ScrollView.scrollEnabled=scrollable (false on phone): the wall section does NOT compete with the outer line-measure-scroll on phones, matching iter-66 fix.
